title: disappointed :(
text: disappointed :(. much smaller than anticipated  - makes a big mess - doesnt juice well -  i can just see it dying rapidly  - being returned - the only good feature that i did like was the suction cups on the bottom to hold it steady  it comes with a teeny glass -  you'd be running carrots all day to get anything out of it and the opening is tiny too ...  i need to make 64 oz of juice per day for my purposes  it would be hours before i could fill up a 64 oz container  i guess you get what you pay for  if you need to make an "occasional" glass of juice then its fine ... but not for my intents and purposes -  disappointed
